_README: GiriKavach shared data contract v1.0. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Neither developer changes a field name, unit, or enum value without the other agreeing in the PR. Schema drift between the FastAPI backend and the XGBoost/Streamlit side is the #1 integration risk on this project.

sensor_reading._description: One merged sample. Node 1 (mountain, via LoRa) + Node 2 (gateway, local sensors). This is the POST body for /ingest.

node_id._note: Every reading must carry node identity. Needed so the PWA can filter alerts to the user's valley.

timestamp_utc._note: ALWAYS UTC on the wire. Convert to IST for display only, never in storage or transport.

rain_duration_min._note: Minutes of continuous active rain in the current event, not total uptime.

soil_moisture_profile._description: RECONCILED FIELD, updated at merge time to match the actual implemented wire format (main.py's TelemetryIn / db.py's SensorReading / pipeline.py's SOIL_CHANNELS all agree on soil_1..soil_5 — this schema previously documented a different, never-implemented soil_moisture_XXcm_pct naming). Node reports ALL 5 depths; deep_soil_moisture_pct is DERIVED from them by the backend (risk_engine.theta_deep_pct()) so both the self-healing pipeline and the ML models are satisfied from one source.

deep_soil_moisture_pct._derivation: theta_deep_pct = soil_4*0.4 + soil_5*0.6 (the 100cm/150cm layers, the actual slip-plane band) — see risk_engine.py's DEEP_SOIL_WEIGHTS and theta_deep_pct(). Computed by the backend from the CLEANED (post self-healing) soil_4/soil_5, NOT sent by the node. This corrects an earlier speculative guess in this file (a 30/60/100cm weighted mean, weights 0.25/0.45/0.30) that was never what risk_engine.py actually implemented — that version was written before the two backends were merged and the real formula was confirmed.
deep_soil_moisture_pct._note: This is the field BOTH ML models AND the false-positive filter's saturation gate consume. Do not change its meaning without updating risk_engine.py, false_positive_filter.py, and main.py's XGBoost feature dict together — they must never drift apart.

slope_pitch_deg._note: From MPU6050 pitch. Static site slope can also be pre-loaded from Bhuvan DEM as a fallback.

pitch_rate_deg_min._note: Rate of tilt change = creep signal.

vibration_intensity._note: SW-420 pulse count over a rolling 15s window, normalized.

stream_depth_cm._note: Water depth = sensor_mount_height - ultrasonic_distance. Median-filtered over 10 readings before use.

rate_of_rise_cm_min._note: dh/dt from consecutive depth readings. >5 cm/min triggers the dam-break safety net REGARDLESS of ML output.

node1_link_fresh._note: False when no LoRa packet in 5 min. When false, landslide inference is SKIPPED (all its features originate at node1) — this is NOT a low-risk finding.

ml_feature_vectors._description: EXACT ordered feature lists. Both the XGBoost models and the TFLM models consume these in THIS ORDER. Changing the order silently corrupts predictions with no error.

output._note: Regressor output, clamped to [0,100] by the backend.

risk_tiers._description: ONE source of truth. Identical strings in firmware, backend, dashboard, PWA, and CAP mapping.

cap_mapping._description: Internal tier -> CAP 1.2 controlled vocabulary. certainty is never 'Observed' from a prediction alone.
cap_mapping._status_note: NEVER default to 'Actual'. CAP is consumed by real emergency infrastructure; a demo payload marked Actual is a false emergency claim.

safety_net_thresholds._description: Raw-physics overrides. These fire the siren REGARDLESS of ML output, and bypass hysteresis. Defence against a silently-wrong model (e.g. the rainless GLOF case).

false_positive_gates._description: Suppression thresholds. See false_positive_filter.py (root — merged into main.py, not under backend/).

api_endpoints._description: Backend contract, as of the merge into a single main.py. Rakesh's dashboard and the PWA both consume these. Persistence (SensorReading + Decision rows) happens as a fire-and-forget background task on every /ingest call — it is not a separate endpoint.
api_endpoints.POST /ingest: Accepts sensor_reading (soil_1..soil_5 + the rest), returns decision object
api_endpoints.GET /alert/text?language=en: Citizen alert wording in a given language, from alert_templates.py
api_endpoints.GET /sitrep: Plain-language LLM ops summary (English only, internal)

decision_object._description: What /ingest and /status return. This is what the dashboard and PWA render.
decision_object.theta_deep_pct: float 0-100 — the deep_soil_moisture_pct actually fed into both the ML models and the filter, exposed for audit
decision_object.reasons: array of strings — why it escalated
decision_object.suppressed: array of strings — what was rejected and why
decision_object.sensor_health_warnings: array of strings — merges the filter's own findings with self-healing's imputation notes, so imputed values are never silently indistinguishable from real ones
decision_object.alert_text: string or null — citizen-facing wording from alert_templates.py, present only at WATCH tier or above
decision_object.alert_text_source: string or null — always "template" (see llm_narrator.py; the LLM never writes citizen-facing text)
decision_object.prearm_active: boolean — whether Open-Meteo pre-arm is currently raising sensitivity

heartbeat._note: Dashboard and PWA both use stale_after_seconds to show the node-offline chip. One value, both consumers.
